caption: The video captures a harbor at low sun, framed by a static camera. The sun rests just above the horizon, partly occluded by a mountain ridge on the right, bathing the sky in pink and lavender tones. A long column of reflected sunlight runs down the calm water, its texture shifting as ripples move across the surface. On the left, white fishing boats are moored at a concrete quay and a low industrial building, while a thin railed pier extends into the water dotted with dark buoys and a white float. The boats, pier, and breakwater remain fixed throughout, as the shimmering highlights within the reflection column continue to drift over the scene.
